title: Evaluation of the next parity layer
statement: Let $n,r,q$ be natural numbers, let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$, and choose an index $i$ in a layer of size $r^q2^r$. The OR gate applied to the specified inputs from the bottom layer at level $q+1$ has the same sign as the OR node at index $i$ in level $q$, whose actual assignment is the assignment of parity-tree values at height $1$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
$i$ is an index in a layer of size $r^q2^r$
